'''Leelee Pace''' was a [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Artisan/Legends|artisan]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order]]. She regularly visited [[Dannar's Claim]] in the [[Pika Oasis/Legends|Pika Oasis]], which was run by her friend [[Annileen Calwell]].
